862-2438-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crimson Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
862-2438-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. Then, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

1168-3510-5929-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
1168-3510-5929-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

141-997-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-997-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2279-3240-4247-6462.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2111-4981-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1739-2781-3375-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2018-2974-4053.description:
Cast Repository Skaab by paying its mana cost.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Luminous Broodmoth and Repository Skaab's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning an instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Repository Skaab from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2

5153-7150-7638.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
5153-7150-7638.description:
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying The Mind Stone's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of The Mind Stone's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-2843-3175.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

855-1806-2060-5147-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

240-647-5231-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

789-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
789-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Gutter Grime and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
789-6797-7084.notes: As Gutter Grime will get more and more slime counters, the final token you make will be infinitely large.

104-2741-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2741-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor

1558-3529-4231-6913.notablePrerequisites: Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3529-4231-6913.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

2034-3000-4476-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-3000-4476-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1796-2292-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
1796-2292-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
1796-2292-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1069-5285-5499-6633.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-5285-5499-6633.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

1329-2178-3652-5315.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3652-5315.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

2438-3951-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
2438-3951-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

527-3995-5963.notablePrerequisites:
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
527-3995-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2239-4377-5626.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} the first turn, with {6}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
2239-4377-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
You have at least {E}.
2239-4377-5626.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}, sacrificing Ardent Elementalist, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1495-4899-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Phyrexian Devourer's ability by exiling the top card of your library, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Marvin equal to the exiled card's mana value.
Repeat step 1 as desired or until you have an empty library.
Activate Marvin using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from Marvin, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as desired.

1636-3197-3654.notablePrerequisites:
Plaguemaw Beast does not have summoning sickness.
Herd Baloth has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-3197-3654.description:
Activate Plaguemaw Beast by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2366-2882-4552-5256.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Blossoming Tortoise.
2366-2882-4552-5256.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield as a copy of Blossoming Tortoise due to Infinite Reflection, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dryad Arbor's power.
Resolve the Dryad Arbor trigger from step 2, causing you to mill three cards and return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

12-657-3266-4550.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two cards in hand.
Beastmaster Ascension has at least five quest counters on it.
12-657-3266-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Kavu Lair and Garruk's Uprising trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

539-1778-3875-4300.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, Lotus Cobra triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Memnite to your hand from the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token with flying.
Repeat.

1283-1987-4311-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

4644-4684.notablePrerequisites: Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
4644-4684.description:
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping itself.
When Tidewater Minion becomes untapped, Mesmeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat.

65-717-864-881-2628.description:
Activate Scattered Groves's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Scattered Groves, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Scattered Groves trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Scattered Groves from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
